note: Typed commands execute like tapped ones: they go over the same relay, land in world.db as source=cli, and an unknown function is registered as a new method on that object for the current agenda only (tappable later). A pasted line is split on ';' (stray ')' dropped); [[safes]] still resolve; loose contains() is fleshed to filter/includes and shown as 'ran as:' beside what you typed.
